tickets.subject: Bulk order PP-2291: 3 bikes missing from delivery
tickets.description:
Hi team,

We received 9 of the 12 Roadster 2 bikes from order PP-2291 today. The delivery note lists all 12. Can you check with the courier?

Lakshmi

messages.body:
Hi Lakshmi,

Sorry about this. The courier split the order into two boxes and the second one is at their Bengaluru hub. I have asked them to deliver it tomorrow before noon.

Arjun
@Kabir Singh the courier says the second box has a torn corner. Can we pre-approve a replacement if a bike is damaged?
Thanks Arjun. Please make sure they call our warehouse before arriving, the gate closes at 1 pm.

Hi Rohan,

New disc brakes often squeak for the first 30 to 50 stops while the pads bed in. Could you try ten firm stops from about 20 km/h and tell us if it continues?

Neha

Hi Fatima,

The helmet reached our warehouse on 18 October and your refund of Rs 3,499 was issued today. It usually takes 5 to 7 working days to show in your account.

Kabir
Got it, thank you for checking.

Hi Vikram,

Done: your order now has the Trail X. We have sent a payment link for the difference of Rs 8,000. Delivery stays on Friday.

Arjun
@Priya Nair this is the second City Glide frame this month from the same batch. Should we raise it with the factory?
Yes, please collect the batch numbers. I will raise it with the factory on Monday.

Hi Aditya,

Yes, we do. I will send a proposal for 40 City Glide e-bikes with quarterly servicing by Thursday. Could you confirm the office locations?

Priya

Hi Rahul,

The courier updates the link a few hours after pickup. It should work by this evening; I will check again tomorrow morning.

Arjun

Hi Imran,

Sorry for the mix-up. We have emailed you a prepaid return label and reserved a size M for you. Could you confirm a pickup date?

Kabir

Hi Suresh,

Yes, we deliver to Coimbatore in 3 to 4 working days, fully assembled. Delivery is free above Rs 10,000.

Neha

Hi Lakshmi,

The visits are on 12 January, 9 February and 9 March, from 10 am. The technician will bring spare tubes and brake pads.

Arjun
